# GeM AI Procurement Compliance Platform

> AI-powered integrated bid compliance verification platform for GeM procurement.

## Capabilities
- Real-time OCR document ingestion and parsing
- NLP entity validation (PAN, GSTIN, Udyam, CA Turnover)
- GFR 2017 & DPIIT Make-in-India automated rule engine
- Cartel anomaly detection via AI
- Digital Compliance Passport system

## Important Pages
- [Homepage](/) - Core dashboard and procurement features
- [Active Tenders](/tenders) - Search and apply for government tenders
- [Live Auctions](/auctions) - Real-time price bidding and anomaly monitoring

## Documentation
Refer to the standard GeM and GFR 2017 guidelines for procurement policies.
